correctness.rationale: Exact Fourier product F_chi F_psi=|A|[psi=chi^(−2)]F_(chi^(−1)), valid because |A| is odd and invertible. The order of chi↦chi^(−2) has no 2-cycles except fixed points. Elementary commutators span W of all nonfixed characters, W is a subalgebra, and the constructive determinant lemma realizes any edge-minor list on every nonfixed cycle. Combining disjoint cycles constructs one pair (u,v) for every target. The zero-width boundary 3A=0 is proved. Standalone finite-field checker tests direct quandle multiplication, group products and characteristic-two edge minors; finite checks are not used in place of the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: This is an exact all-rank, all-odd-order single-commutator realization theorem over splitting fields. Previously inspected results report finite commutator-width tables, an exact linear commutator span, or quandle-level commutativization. value.rationale: It answers the motivated commutator-width question exactly for every odd-order abelian core quandle over a natural Fourier-splitting field, including arbitrarily high group rank and arbitrarily large odd order. The constructive proof upgrades a known linear span classification to a nonlinear exact image theorem and distinguishes a semisimple splitting-field regime from known modular width-two behavior.
